description: ASTRO CARE is a team interested in developing innovative software solutions for astronaut health monitoring during space missions. We aim to explore technology, coding, data analysis, and creative problem-solving to address health challenges faced by astronauts. We welcome enthusiastic members with interests in software development, AI/ML, data analysis, UI/UX design, and healthcare technology who are eager to learn, collaborate, and innovate.
summary: AstroCare is a smart astronaut health monitoring application designed to support astronauts' physical and mental well-being during space missions. The system focuses on monitoring important health indicators such as heart rate, blood oxygen saturation (SpO₂), body temperature, sleep patterns, stress and fatigue. It provides a centralised dashboard to display health readings, visualise changes over time and identify unusual patterns. Using data analysis and rule-based alerts, AstroCare highlights potential health concerns that may require attention. It also includes health reports and wellness tracking to help astronauts understand their health conditions throughout a mission. By combining Python, data visualisation and machine learning concepts, AstroCare aims to support early awareness of health risks and improve astronaut health monitoring. This project addresses the challenges of maintaining physical and mental health in the demanding environment of space.
details:
AstroCare – Astronaut Health Monitoring Application

Overview:
AstroCare is a software prototype designed to support astronaut health and wellness during long-duration space missions. Space environments can affect physical health, sleep, stress and overall well-being. AstroCare brings important health indicators together in a single dashboard.

How It Works:
The application processes health data using Python and Pandas. It displays heart rate, blood oxygen saturation (SpO₂), body temperature, sleep patterns, stress and fatigue indicators. Plotly charts help users understand changes over time, while rule-based alerts highlight unusual readings that may require attention.

Key Features:

  • Unified astronaut health dashboard.
  • Health indicator visualization.
  • Sleep and wellness tracking.
  • Health trend analysis.
  • Rule-based alerts for unusual readings.
  • Health report generation.

Benefits and Intended Impact:
AstroCare aims to improve health awareness, simplify health-data review and support informed decision-making during space missions.

Tools and Technologies:
Python, Streamlit, Pandas and Plotly.

Creative Approach:
The project combines physical health indicators and wellness tracking in one accessible interface. It is designed as a prototype and decision-support aid, not a medical diagnostic system.

Future Scope:
Wearable-device integration, additional NASA research-data integration and advanced health trend analysis.
